system_a.summary: Guests across the review history describe a private, basement-level apartment with a separate entrance, in a quiet, scenic mountain neighborhood south of Asheville. Recent reviews (2024–2026) are consistently positive, praising cleanliness, space, value, easy check-in, responsive hosts, and convenience to Asheville and Biltmore. Several recent guests mention a peaceful setting and useful amenities. Recent reports of limitations include a hill walk from parking that may challenge older guests, and one 2022 comment about a narrow path to the door. Older reviews (historical) raise recurring concerns: a sagging bed, no curtains or blinds, a door that could not be locked, steep or muddy parking, noise from upstairs, cool temperatures with limited control, and weak water pressure. A few historical stays involved unfriendly host communication and a refund dispute. Overall, reports describe a simple, no-frills, good-value stay, though recent reviews do not confirm whether older issues persist.

selected_claims.claim: Door to the private entrance reportedly could not be locked, and the unit had no curtains or blinds (privacy concern). Reports come from 2015 and 2019, and one 2019 reviewer also said the door to upstairs guests and garage could not be locked and the garage door was left open for long periods. One 2015 reviewer saw the neighborhood as safe, and another said their wife was bothered.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Reports date from 2015 to 2019; none in the recent period (2024-2026) mention locks or window coverings.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Current lock and window-covering status is unknown; the issue may have been addressed or may persist.

selected_claims.claim: Steep driveway and hill, a narrow passage to the door (about 2 feet between stairs and wall), and a long walk uphill from parking were reported. One 2024 reviewer said the walk can be challenging for older people, and one guest wished for driveway drop-off.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Reports span 2017-2024; the most recent (March 2024) is about the uphill walk.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Small minority of reviewers; other guests described parking as easy or fine, so experience likely varies with mobility and vehicle.

selected_claims.claim: Hosts' footsteps overhead were audible, and one guest reported loud stomping from 5:30AM after being asked to be quiet. Most reviewers describe the place as quiet and peaceful.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Noise complaints from 2017 and 2019; quiet reports continue through 2025.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Two reviewers reported overhead noise; the rest of the many quiet reports do not mention it, so the issue may depend on host activity.

selected_claims.claim: Bed comfort is divided: many guests called the bed comfortable, but some reported sagging or a sinking middle that caused backaches. Others noted cool nights, limited temperature control, and needing extra blankets.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Bed complaints are from 2018-2019; positive bed comments run 2016-2021 and general comfort praise continues to 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No recent bed complaints, but also few recent bed-specific comments, so current bed condition is unverified.

selected_claims.claim: Two guests described weak water pressure with a toilet near-overflow, and a host response blaming the guest and telling them to vacate immediately. Another reported a refused partial refund and a 2017 guest described aloof host messages. Most guests describe hosts as responsive and welcoming.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Negative host reports are from 2017-2019; positive responsiveness reports continue through July 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: The plumbing problem is a single 2019 report; no evidence on current plumbing or host handling.

selected_claims.claim: Cleanliness is widely praised across years, including recent stays. Minor exceptions: two spiders in a bathroom (2019) and no soap in the bathroom (2019).
selected_claims.time_qualification: Consistent praise 2014-2026; the negative notes are from 2019.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Reports are extracted from reviews and not independently verified.

selected_claims.claim: Check-in is frequently described as easy and seamless, with a private entrance, coded or self-managed entry and clear instructions. Minor exceptions: confusing house numbering, GPS trouble, and a steep tenant parking location.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Positive reports run 2015-2026; confusion reports are from 2015-2017.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Wording is repeated across several reviews, so counts may not reflect fully independent experiences.

selected_claims.claim: Value and location are consistently praised: affordable, near Asheville and the Biltmore (roughly 10-20 minutes from downtown), with highway access. A car is needed, and the mountainside roads are steep.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Pricing may have changed over time; current rates are not shown in the evidence.

selected_claims.claim: The unit is a basic, no-frills basement suite with essentials such as a mini fridge, coffee, heater and Wi-Fi. Listing accuracy is mostly confirmed, though one guest said the patio differed from the photos and another noticed a per-guest fee.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Accuracy confirmations run 2015-2026; patio and fee concerns are from 2017-2019.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Whether the patio or fee disclosures have changed is unknown; one 2022 guest advised it suits sleeping and showering more than extended time.
